limits: Reference capture is measured against the frozen finite public reference corpus, not a worldwide deal population.
Robotics dominates the reference corpus; digital small rounds and engineering categories are less independently tested.
China and India have targeted references, not exhaustive local-language or proprietary coverage.
Existing source-rule classifications remain explicit and were sampled, not all individually recertified.
Unknown funding amounts are missing values, not zero; reported packages, bounds and round components are marked.
Excluded cells must not be labeled cold, no activity, or used to infer volume growth.
For deal counts use episode first public disclosure; for financing amounts retain dated incremental disclosures and avoid adding repeated episode totals.
October 1–11 is display-only for verified disclosures.
